headline: Static Balance vs. Continuous Solvency
subhead: Autonomous leverage requires continuous risk infrastructure to prevent liquidation.

blocks.text: Static Wallet Balance: Fixed ledger tracking with zero automated solvency calculation.
Continuous Solvency: Dynamic health factor derived on demand from collateral against debt.
Deterministic risk computation is essential for autonomous agent credit rails.

focal.reason: Focuses the visual hierarchy on real-time calculated health factors over passive balances.
